QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Officer of the Day
QuestInfo.0: Yoria is running a Lunar New Year Video Message Project. She's helping deliver messages between officers and their families while they aid in Maple World's restoration! But who will be Officer of the Day?
QuestInfo.1:
Today's lucky Officer of the Day is Neinheart!
You'll find Neinheart at the #bentrance to the Lunar New Year party#k. Tell him all about the Lunar New Year Video Message Project!
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart refused to participate until Claudine jumped in. Talk to Neinheart again.

default.0: Neinheart is at the #bentrance to the Lunar New Year party#n#k.
